manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A motion arrow shrinks to nothing at the top while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark and falls back on a fixed height scale. The blue motion arrow shortens, vanishes at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. Playback pauses at the top.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(time,T));const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const v=u-g*t;const ta=u/g;const top=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const y0=360,ppm=190;const by=y0-h*ppm-14;const bx=200;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:20,y:40,w:600,h:370,title:'Tossed ball',state:st}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',100,y0,300,y0,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',105,y0+16,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.axis('axis.h',{x:80,y:y0,length:280,orientation:'y',min:0,max:1.47,ticks:[0,0.5,1],label:'Height',unit:'m'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',bx,by,28,{role:'observed'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:bx+34,y:by},{value:v,direction:'up'},{scale:14,minLength:12,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:bx-34,y:by},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:5,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(400,200,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:u*u/(2*g),velocity:v,height:h}};}
